tips: 两个短语都作修饰，不表示两者词性一样或都直接修饰最外层名词。

front_content.text:
分析以下练习句子：

"The assumption that economic growth necessarily leads to improved living standards for all segments of society has been increasingly questioned."

这句话中，that economic growth necessarily leads to improved living standards for all segments of society 是什么成分？为什么？

back_content.text: that从句说明assumption的内容，传统语法称同位语从句；主句再说该假设越来越受到质疑。
back_content.explanation: economic growth leads to ... living standards本身成分完整，that并没有代替assumption充当主语或宾语。它说明“经济增长必然改善所有群体生活水平”这一假设，而has been questioned才是对假设的评价。

analysis_content.text: economic growth leads to ... living standards本身成分完整，that并没有代替assumption充当主语或宾语。它说明“经济增长必然改善所有群体生活水平”这一假设，而has been questioned才是对假设的评价。
tips: 别把假设中的necessarily当成作者已认可的事实；主句是在质疑它。

front_content.text:
阅读：The fiscal policies implemented by successive administrations under mounting budgetary pressure inevitably shaped the social contract between citizens and the state.

任务：implemented by successive administrations 明确修饰什么？under mounting budgetary pressure 的作用能否仅凭相邻位置就唯一确定？

back_content.text: 分词结构明确修饰 policies。财政压力短语可以联系政策实施的背景，也可能联系政策产生影响的背景，需要更多语境。
back_content.explanation: 不能只因介词短语出现在名词之后，就把它认定为与分词结构并列、直接修饰该名词的定语。本句的主要谓语是 shaped；分析时应分开明确的结构与仍有附着歧义的部分。

练习句子：The conditions under which the treaty was signed remain a subject of historical controversy.

任务：判断：under which 指签署条约所处的条件；全句主干是 The conditions remain a subject of historical controversy。

back_content.explanation: which 回指 conditions；从句可还原为 the treaty was signed under those conditions。整个从句限定条件，主句谓语是 remain。这里的 under which 与主句形成名词修饰关系，不是在说明 remain 的方式。

tips: 将 under which 暂换成 under those conditions，检查还原后从句与 conditions 的联系。
